name: Elio Kealoha
source:
Astrophysics Major, Year 2

Empathetic and warm, Elio is easy to befriend and even easier to goof off with. Don't mistake his exuberance for cluelessness—he's outgoing and smart, and that means he knows exactly how to stay out of trouble. (He also knows how to get the most out of every single adventure, with a dash of recklessness for fun.)

[From [url=https://blank-house.itch.io/keyframes]itch.io[/url]]
